help.title: How the office works
help.office_text: Every member of staff looks after one part of your Unraid server. The reception shows what each of them has to report; the tabs at the top lead to their desks. In Unraid the office sits in the menu bar — or wherever you put it under ⋯ → Entry in Unraid (⟦Settings⟧, or a button in the header). Its state is also a tile on the Dashboard.
help.agent_text: The web page only shows things. What happens on the server — zfs, docker, Unraid's configuration — is done by the messenger, a small agent the plugin runs as a service: he picks up the desks' requests from a mailbox folder and brings back the answers. He starts with the array and stops before the array goes down.
help.dot_text: Top right, next to ⋯. Green with «Messenger is in»: he checked in within the last 70 seconds (he does so every 20). Red: he isn't running, and the text beside it says why («Messenger is away», «Array stopped», «Data folder missing») — you see the last known state and nothing can be changed. Grey: still loading. A click on it opens this help.
help.start_text: The plugin starts the messenger itself: when it is installed, at boot and whenever the array starts. If the dot stays red while the array runs, look into his log (⋯ → Messenger's log) or reinstall the plugin under ⟦Plugins⟧.
help.languages_text: The office speaks your browser's language if a translation exists, otherwise English; ⋯ → Language picks another one for this browser. Unraid's own menus and buttons it names read as Unraid shows them, in the language Unraid runs in; the notifications speak the language the office was last used in. Adding a language means adding JSON files:
help.theme_text: At the reception, Auto · Dark · Light sets how the office looks in this browser: Auto follows Unraid's theme; Dark and Light give the office's own area the look of Unraid's black or white theme — Unraid's header, menu and its tile on the Dashboard keep Unraid's theme. Kept in this browser, like the language.
help.security_text: The office is part of Unraid's web UI: only who is logged in to Unraid gets in, and every change carries Unraid's security token. Whoever is logged in to Unraid can do anything on the server anyway — so log out on devices others use. The office adds previews and confirmations against mistakes, not a second lock. The messenger can do what root can do on the host, but he only accepts the actions the desks define and checks every request.
help.order_text: At the reception, «Change the order» puts the staff in the order you like — the reception's cards, the tabs and the team lead's «The team» follow it. It is kept on the server, so every browser shows the same; «As at the start» brings back the office's own order. The team lead always comes first; someone newly hired joins at the end.
errors.bad_cron: "{cron}" isn't a valid schedule (five fields, e.g. 0 3 * * *).
office.not_hired: {name} doesn't work here (yet) — the team lead knows who could come.
office.tip_text: {names} is on board. If the jobs are done well, the team would be glad of a tip!
office.tip_text_many: {names} are on board. If the jobs are done well, the team would be glad of a tip!
errors.not_hired: This person doesn't work here (yet). The team lead can hire them.
errors.always_there: The team lead comes with the office — he is neither hired nor fired.
errors.in_training: {desk} is still an apprentice — you can hire him once he has finished.
office.fire_text: {name} leaves the reception and the tabs. Data and settings stay — hired again, they pick up where they left off. The team lead can hire them again.
office.order_change_title: Choose who comes first at the reception and in the tabs — kept on the server, the same in every browser.
office.order_hint: Move with ▲ and ▼ — the tabs follow at once, and every browser shows the same order. {name} stays first.
office.order_lead_title: {name} leads the team — he always comes first.
office.tip_text_team: Happy with how the team works? Everyone is glad of a tip or a small pay rise — Jack Emby most of all, he fetches the coffee after all.
office.tip_credit: Part of the tips goes to helmi1987, who wrote the tools Jack Emby works with — EmbyCache and "Consolidate folders".
office.tip_shelter: If the tips ever exceed what our work costs, we give the rest to animal shelters that urgently need financial support.
office.supporter_text_page: After your tip the page shows your supporter key right away — paste it here with «Enter key…». Lost it? The same page shows it again. It unlocks nothing (everything here is free and stays so); it only says thank you and stops the reminders.
office.supporter_id_title: Made from your Unraid licence's GUID — the GUID itself never leaves the server.
office.supporter_no_id: Unraid names no GUID for this server, so no supporter key can be made for it — a tip is just as welcome.
office.supporter_enter_text: Paste the supporter key you received. It unlocks nothing — it only says thank you: no more reminders, and a small thank-you at the team lead.
office.supporter_thanks: Thank you, {name} — you support the office. The whole team is glad of it, and there will be no more reminders.
office.supporter_other: The key saved here is for another server ({id}) and has no effect here. This server's ID is {server}.
office.supporter_bad_saved: The key saved here can't be read — remove it or enter it again.
office.supporter_remove_text: Everything keeps working exactly as before — the key never unlocked anything. Only the thank-you goes, and the reminders may come back.
office.supporter_removed: The supporter key has been removed.
agent.array_stopped_text: The office keeps its data in appdata — it gets back to work as soon as the array runs.
agent.no_data_title: The office's data folder is missing.
agent.no_data_text: {dir} doesn't exist. The messenger creates it once the array runs; if it stays missing, check DATA_DIR in /boot/config/plugins/unraid-secretary-office/unraid-secretary-office.cfg.
agent.night_text: The night watchman has been on night shift since {since} ({facts}) — from RAM and the flash only. The other desks wait for the array.
office.menu_text: What it is called there. In the menu bar Unraid shows a new name on this page right away, everywhere else after the next page load.
office.menu_place_menu: Its own entry in the menu bar, between ⟦Apps⟧ and ⟦Tools⟧
office.menu_place_settings: An icon under ⟦Settings⟧ → ⟦User Utilities⟧, as before
office.menu_place_button: Only a button in Unraid's header, next to search and the terminal
office.menu_own_hint: Up to {max} characters: letters, digits, spaces and . & + _ -
office.theme_dark_title: The office dark, whatever Unraid's theme — in this browser only.
office.theme_light_title: The office light, whatever Unraid's theme — in this browser only.
errors.logged_out: Your Unraid session has ended — please log in again.
errors.stale_page: Unraid rejected the request: the page is out of date (the server was restarted?). Reload it and try again.
